evidence: ALD of MoOx: Amorphous molybdenum oxide was deposited from molybdenum hexacarbonyl [Mo(CO) 6] (Gelest, USA) and ozone (O 3) at 170 °C in a flow type custom build reactor using N2 (99.995%) as carrier and purging gas. Dose time of each precursor was kept 1 s and the purge time in between the two consecutive doses was kept at 15 s.
